profile.name: Manuel Bolaños
profile.tagline: A decade shipping the web stack — now wiring LLMs and microcontrollers into the loop.
profile.summary: Full-stack web developer with over a decade of experience and 200+ delivered projects, now deliberately expanding into AI and embedded systems. My core is the web stack — PHP, Laravel, WordPress, React and JavaScript — backed by solid experience leading teams as Scrum Master and Technical Lead under agile methodologies. I am building on that foundation with the integration of AI agents and LLMs into real products, plus hands-on ESP32 firmware (C/C++) and IoT devices.
profile.hybrid: The result is a rare hybrid profile: equally comfortable shipping a Laravel application, building a professional website, wiring an LLM into the loop, and flashing firmware to a microcontroller.
